name: Malice (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus hexcrafter archetype

Benefit: A hexcrafter magus’s attacks are enhanced by the spiteful link between her and her opponent. Her melee attacks deal +2d6 damage to any opponent that is currently under the effects of one of her hexes.
